brand.name: MapMyEscape
brand.tagline: Ditch the Rigid Itinerary. Escape Your Way.
brand.subheading: Tell us your starting point, favorite vibes—temples, treks, cafes, beaches—and let AI plot an interactive real-time route mapped out day by day.

hints.title: Pick Your Travel Vibe
hints.description: Choose what you crave—hidden cafes, sacred temples, mountain treks, beaches, or waterfalls.

hints.title: AI Calculates the Route
hints.description: Get a sequenced day-by-day plan with travel times, durations, and coordinates between stops.

hints.title: Interactive Real-Time Map
hints.description: Zoom and fly to any spot on the live map, inspect details, or tap 'Change Itinerary' to remix.

presets.title: Manali Treks & Bohemian Cafes
presets.description: Scenic alpine trails, Hadimba forest temple, riverside cafes, and Jogini Waterfall.

presets.title: Goa Sunsets, Forts & Shacks
presets.description: Cliffside cafes, Vagator sunset point, Saturday night market, and secluded northern beaches.

presets.title: Rishikesh Waterfalls & Ganga Ghats
presets.description: Morning Ganga aarti, Beatles Ashram, secret Neer Garh waterfall hike, and rooftop German bakeries.
